scope: panel-only Queue Manager Ask panel add-on
notes: Ask panel calls existing queue ask command through qrun.
Provider discovery uses queue ask --help, bundled helper binaries, and examples/providers/ai/*.env.example.
Panel does not implement provider policy, audit, safety classification, live enablement, approval, override, submission, or execution logic.
queuebash.sh and QUEUEBASH_VERSION are intentionally unchanged to honour the panel-only sidestep.
